description:
• About our brand and products:

Brand: rulaer


We specialize in custom-made high-density foam seat cushions, providing personalized support solutions for those who sit for long periods, office workers, pregnant women, drivers, and users who prioritize seating comfort.

Core Products

Custom-sized seat cushion (fits any chair/wheelchair/car seat)

Multiple densities available (soft/medium/firm, matched to weight and posture)

Removable breathable cover (non-slip sole + machine washable)

Optional features: memory foam layer, cooling fabric, antibacterial and anti-mite treatment


• What makes us different:

Not a generic model, but "tailor-made"

Users simply upload a photo of the chair and fill in their seating posture preferences, and we can precisely cut the foam to achieve a "chair shape = seat cushion shape," completely solving the problems of slippage and size mismatch.


DTC independent website + low-competition niche category

Blue ocean market, high customization premium, users are less price-sensitive


• How affiliates can earn:

We offer a high-conversion, high-commission affiliate partnership model:


Commission Rate: 5%–10% per order (tiered system, higher monthly sales result in higher commission rates)Cookie Duration: 30 days (purchases made within 30 days of a user's click count towards your performance)


Bonus Rewards:


Exclusive discount codes provided


Settlement Method: Settlement on the 15th of each month (PayPal / Bank Transfer / Platform Automatic Settlement)


• How to promote us:

Exclusive promotional link + discount code

Material package: High-definition scene images, comparison images (general-purpose cushions vs. custom-made cushions), short videos addressing user pain points, authorized buyer show images

Suggested promotional channels:

Content-based: Chair review bloggers, ergonomic accounts, home goods accounts, pregnancy and childbirth bloggers, truck driver communities


Paid-based: Google Shopping targeted keywords (custom-made cushions, tailbone pain cushions)


Community-based: Lumbar disc herniation groups, office renovation groups, RV modification forums


Custom content collaboration supported: Free samples available for video/text/image requests.


• Other information:

Shipping & After-Sales Service: Worldwide shipping (7-15 days to Europe and America), 30-day no-reason return policy (customized products only applicable to unused items).Partnership Requirements: No inventory required, no customer service needed; we handle fulfillment.

Application Method: Submit application on our official website / Contact us via email / Register on an affiliate platform (such as ShareASale, UpPromote).
